description: crawltest scenarios for list, toggle, and dashboard flows
spec:
1. Define crawltest scenarios covering the habit list page.
2. Cover creating a habit and seeing it in the list.
3. Cover toggling today done and observing the streak change.
4. Cover the dashboard done-vs-total count and weekly grid.
5. Cover the archive flow removing a habit from the active list.
6. Run the crawltest against affected routes and confirm no console errors.
7. Confirm `bun run smoke:qc` passes with scenarios in place.
8. Verify duplicate same-day check-ins cannot be produced through the UI.
9. Confirm empty-state rendering when all habits are archived.
10. Capture evidence (screenshots) for the primary flows.
title: Crawl testing scenarios
